Question 7

A thin rod with mass density function λ(x)=6x, measured in kg/m, is placed along the x-axis over the interval 1≤x≤2, where x is measured in meters. Find the moment of the rod about the origin.

a
9kg⋅m
b
16kg⋅m
c
14kg⋅m
d
7kg⋅m
e
12kg⋅m
